title: Overcharge in Dispute on Single-Use Card Purchases — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Disputes Manual
content:
**Disputes manual clause, Pocketwire Visa Debit Card.** This clause sets the amount disputed as an incorrect amount on a purchase made with a single-use virtual card. A single-use card by design carries one purchase, so the card's settled purchase, its authorizations and its merchant credits all belong to that purchase.

**The overcharge in dispute** is the settled purchase amount less the authorized reference, less the gratuity allowance, less the exchange allowance, and less the merchant credits counted. It is never below zero and never more than the settled purchase amount, and it is rounded to the cent (half up).

1. *Settled purchase amount*: the settled amount of the card's purchase.
2. *Authorized reference*: the amount of the authorization that the purchase settled against.
3. *Gratuity allowance*: the gratuity rate applied to the authorized reference. *Exchange allowance*: the exchange rate tolerance applied to the authorized reference. Each is rounded to the cent (half up). Both rates are 0 percent.
4. *Merchant credits counted*: the merchant credits linked to the purchase.

**Bases and order.** Both allowances are worked on the authorized reference, not on the settled amount, and each is rounded to the cent on its own. The authorized reference, both allowances and the merchant credits counted are all deducted from the settled purchase amount. The result is then held between zero and the settled purchase amount and rounded to the cent.

### Worked figures (hypothetical purchases)

| Settled purchase | Authorization settled against | Linked merchant credits | Working | Overcharge in dispute |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 62.40 | 48.00 | 5.00 | 62.40 less 48.00, less 0.00, less 0.00, less 5.00 | 9.40 |
| 75.00 | 60.00 | none | 75.00 less 60.00 | 15.00 |
| 30.00 | 30.00 | 2.00 | 30.00 less 30.00, less 2.00, is below zero | 0.00 |

In each row both allowances are 0.00, since a 0 percent rate applied to the authorized reference gives 0.00.
